name: Pneumatic ATC
author: ncSender
description: Pneumatic automatic tool changer workflow helper. Uses a single aux output to clamp/unclamp the collet.

PRESSURE_FAULT.title: Air Pressure Low
PRESSURE_FAULT.message:
The air-pressure sensor is not reporting enough pressure to work the drawbar, so the tool change cannot safely continue.

Check that the compressor is running and up to pressure, the regulator is set correctly, and no line is kinked or disconnected. Once pressure is restored, click "Re-check" — the macro reads the sensor again and only carries on if it now reads good. Click "Abort" to stop the tool change.

PRESSURE_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.title: Air Pressure Still Low
PRESSURE_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.message:
Pressure has been re-checked twice and is still below what the drawbar needs.

Continuing does not mean the problem is fixed. The tool change will carry on without confirmed air pressure, which risks the drawbar not opening or closing fully — a tool can be left loose in the spindle or dropped. Only continue if you have a reason to believe the sensor is wrong rather than the air.

Click "Abort" to stop the tool change, which is the safe choice.

DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_OPEN.title: Drawbar Did Not Open
DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_OPEN.message:
The drawbar was released but the drawbar sensor never reported it open, so the tool change has stopped here. The drawbar has been clamped again, so nothing is left loose.

Check the air supply, the solenoid, and the drawbar sensor and its wiring.

Click "Retry" to release the drawbar again and re-check the sensor, or "Abort" to stop the tool change.

DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_OPEN_FINAL.title: Drawbar Still Not Open
DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_OPEN_FINAL.message:
The drawbar sensor still does not report the drawbar open after two retries. The drawbar is clamped and the tool change can't go on.

Click "Abort" to stop the tool change, then check the air supply, the solenoid, and the drawbar sensor and its wiring.

To run without this check, turn the sensor off in the Pneumatic ATC settings. The tool change is then no longer checked here.

DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_CLOSE.title: Drawbar Did Not Close
DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_CLOSE.message:
The drawbar was clamped but the drawbar sensor still reports it open, so the tool may not be gripped. The tool change has stopped here rather than move.

Support the tool. Check the air supply, the solenoid, and that nothing is fouling the drawbar or the pull stud.

Click "Retry" to clamp again and re-check the sensor, or "Abort" to stop the tool change.

DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_CLOSE_FINAL.title: Drawbar Still Not Closed
DRAWBAR_FAILED_TO_CLOSE_FINAL.message:
The drawbar sensor still reports the drawbar open after two retries, so the tool may not be gripped.

Support the tool, then click "Abort" to stop the tool change.

To run without this check, turn the sensor off in the Pneumatic ATC settings. The tool change is then no longer checked here.

TOOL_FAILED_TO_SEAT.title: No Tool In Spindle
TOOL_FAILED_TO_SEAT.message:
The drawbar closed, but the tool sensor does not detect a tool in the spindle. The holder may be mis-seated, the slot may have been empty, or the tool did not come up with the drawbar.

Click "Retry" to re-check the tool sensor, or "Abort" to stop the tool change.

TOOL_FAILED_TO_SEAT_FINAL.title: Tool Still Not Detected
TOOL_FAILED_TO_SEAT_FINAL.message:
The tool sensor still does not detect a tool in the spindle after two retries.

Click "Abort" to stop the tool change, then inspect the slot and the spindle taper.

To run without this check, turn the sensor off in the Pneumatic ATC settings. The tool change is then no longer checked here.

TOOL_STILL_GRIPPED.title: Tool Did Not Release
TOOL_STILL_GRIPPED.message:
The spindle lifted away from the slot but the tool sensor still detects a tool, so the tool did not stay behind in the rack.

Check that the holder dropped cleanly into the slot and is not hung up on the cup or fork, and that the drawbar is fully open.

Click "Retry" to re-check the tool sensor, or "Abort" to stop the tool change.

TOOL_STILL_GRIPPED_FINAL.title: Tool Still in Spindle
TOOL_STILL_GRIPPED_FINAL.message:
The tool sensor still detects a tool in the spindle after two retries.

Click "Abort" to stop the tool change, then remove the tool by hand.

To run without this check, turn the sensor off in the Pneumatic ATC settings. The tool change is then no longer checked here.

TOOLRACK_FAULT.title: Tool Rack Not Available
TOOLRACK_FAULT.message: Rack not confirmed out by its sensor. Check it moves freely, then Re-check, or Abort.

TOOLRACK_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.title: Tool Rack Still Not Available
TOOLRACK_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.message: Rack still not confirmed out. Continuing is unverified and may crash. Abort is safe.

TOOLRACK_RETRACT_FAULT.title: Tool Rack Not Retracted
TOOLRACK_RETRACT_FAULT.message: Rack not confirmed retracted. Check it moves freely, then Re-check, or Abort.

TOOLRACK_RETRACT_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.title: Tool Rack Still Not Retracted
TOOLRACK_RETRACT_FAULT_UNVERIFIED.message: Rack still not confirmed retracted. Continuing is unverified and may crash. Abort is safe.

UNEXPECTED_TOOL_DETECTED.title: Tool Found In Spindle
UNEXPECTED_TOOL_DETECTED.message: Tool in spindle but T0 assumed. Hold it, Continue opens drawbar. Or Abort, M61 Qn, rerun.

UNEXPECTED_TOOL_REMOVE.title: Remove The Tool
UNEXPECTED_TOOL_REMOVE.message: Drawbar open. Remove the tool, then Continue. Abort to stop.

SPINDLE_NOT_EMPTY.title: Spindle Not Empty
SPINDLE_NOT_EMPTY.message: Tool sensor still sees a tool. Release the drawbar and remove it, then Re-check. Abort to stop.

SPINDLE_NOT_EMPTY_UNVERIFIED.title: Spindle Still Not Empty
SPINDLE_NOT_EMPTY_UNVERIFIED.message: Still sees a tool. Carrying on may crash into the rack. Abort is the safe choice.

FAILED_UNLOAD_TOOL.title: Unload Failed
FAILED_UNLOAD_TOOL.message: Failed to unload {toolNumber}. Please manually remove the bit, then click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.

FAILED_LOAD_TOOL.title: Load Failed
FAILED_LOAD_TOOL.message: Failed to load {toolNumber}. Please manually install the bit, then click "Continue" to proceed or "Abort" to cancel.

MANUAL_UNLOAD_TOOL.title: Manual Unload
MANUAL_UNLOAD_TOOL.message: Click Release to open the drawbar. Remove tool {toolNumber}, then click Continue. Or click Abort to cancel.

MANUAL_LOAD_TOOL.title: Manual Load
MANUAL_LOAD_TOOL.message: Click Release to open the drawbar. Insert tool {toolNumber}, click Clamp to close it, then click Continue.

MANUAL_CLAMP_TOOL.title: Manual Load
MANUAL_CLAMP_TOOL.message: Insert tool {toolNumber}, click Clamp to close the drawbar, then click Continue.

MANUAL_SWAP_TOOL.title: Manual Swap
MANUAL_SWAP_TOOL.message: Click Release to open the drawbar. Remove the current tool, insert tool {toolNumber}, click Clamp to close the drawbar, then click Continue.

MANUAL_QUICK_UNLOAD_TOOL.title: Manual Unload
MANUAL_QUICK_UNLOAD_TOOL.message: Hold tool {toolNumber}, then click Release & Clamp: the drawbar opens for a moment and closes again, so the tool drops into your hand. Then click Continue.

MANUAL_QUICK_LOAD_TOOL.title: Manual Load
MANUAL_QUICK_LOAD_TOOL.message: Hold tool {toolNumber} up in the spindle, then click Release & Clamp: the drawbar opens for a moment and closes on it. Then click Continue.

MANUAL_QUICK_SWAP_TOOL.title: Manual Swap
MANUAL_QUICK_SWAP_TOOL.message: Hold the current tool and click Release & Clamp: Old Tool: the drawbar opens for a moment so it drops into your hand. Then hold tool {toolNumber} up in the spindle and click Release & Clamp: New Tool. Then click Continue.
